dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, well-defined pale boundaries against darker gray-brown feather bodies along the secondaries and primaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness; characterized by a non-linear, gradual transition from fine cranial striations to broader mantle scalloping.

other_distinctive_markers: A light blue identification band is visible on the left tarsus.
